data.description:
## Summary
Restructure ci-llm-review-runner.sh so overlay agents fire in parallel with the main tier reviewer (Proposal 1: hoist + inline per-tier branch).

## Testing Mode
GREEN — make the RED tests from task 79f1-8343 pass.

## Acceptance Criteria
- GIVEN a diff triggering standard/light tier with overlay flags set
  WHEN ci-llm-review-runner.sh executes
  THEN tier call and overlay calls launch with `&` concurrently; single `wait` collects all
- GIVEN a diff triggering deep tier with overlays
  WHEN ci-llm-review-runner.sh executes
  THEN overlay calls launch with `&` in the same fan-out as the 3 specialists; arch synthesis runs after wait for all (specialists + overlays)
- Security blue-team still dispatched AFTER the wait confirms red-team slot file is populated (DD3 preserved)
- All existing tests pass

## Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/scripts/ci-llm-review-runner.sh
  - Move `_run_overlay_llm()` definition to before the tier dispatch case statement (hoist to file scope)
  - Standard/light branch (lines 163-176): add overlay `&` launches before/alongside the tier call; add PID array; single `wait`
  - Deep tier branch (lines 89-160): add overlay `&` launches alongside the 3 specialists; extend PID array; wait for all (specialists + overlays); then arch synthesis
  - Remove the now-dissolved standalone overlay block (lines 182-219) — overlay logic is inline in each branch

## Implementation Notes
Approach selected: Proposal 1 (hoist + inline per-tier branch).
- Standard/light branch becomes: fire tier call with `&`, fire overlay calls with `&`, collect PIDs, wait all, read slot files
- Deep branch becomes: fire 3 specialists with `&`, fire overlay calls with `&`, collect PIDs, wait all, then run arch synthesis with the slot files from specialists
- Security blue-team dispatch: after wait, check if red-team slot file exists/non-empty before dispatching blue-team (same condition as current code, line 208-214)
data.title: Hoist _run_overlay_llm and launch overlays concurrent with tier in ci-llm-review-runner.sh
